hits.text: What's the next big memecoin? (327 replies)
hits.hook: What's the next big memecoin? (327 replies)
hits.draft_en:
@grok you get $25 and one memecoin ticker. What are you naming it, and what's the lore?
Best human answer in the replies gets a follow.
hits.video_tip: No video needed — text + reply play.
hits.draft_note: Don't promise money; swap the follow for a real prize only if you offer one.

hits.name: Crypto Bitlord
hits.text: L2s are useless, return to mainnet (Abstract winding down)
hits.hook: L2s are useless, return to mainnet (Abstract winding down)
hits.draft_en:
Every new L2 splits the same liquidity into thinner slices.
Maybe the next cycle isn't more chains. Maybe it's fewer, louder ones.
Mainnet or L2? One word.
hits.video_tip: Liquidity pie cutting into smaller wedges + poll overlay, <10s.
hits.draft_note: Only say 'another L2 shuts down' if you name a real, recent shutdown.

hits.hook: Zero-lore $60m memecoin vs 'Nvidia training files' coin
hits.draft_en:

Zero-lore coins moon, then vanish. Story coins build a tribe that outlasts the candle.
